commuteAccess.summary: Ränneborg has workable Eksjö-side public transport and pickup access. Skuruhatt has strong designated parking/pickup at Skurugata/Skuruhatt but weak public transport; nearest verified bus stops are 6 km or more away.

start.name: Eksjö Västra Brudbadet
start.caveats: Closest verified active JLT stop found near the GPX start. Timetable PDF valid 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14. Official source mentions a bus stop Ränneborg, but an active JLT stop with that exact name was not verified.

start.name: Eksjö Ränneslätt
start.caveats: Useful Ränneslätt access but farther than Eksjö Västra Brudbadet. Timetable PDF valid 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14.

start.name: Eksjö Resecentrum
start.caveats: Best practical regional hub; not the closest stop by straight-line distance.

start.name: Ränneborgs Idrottsplats / HÖ16-HÖ17 ledentré
start.caveats: Best direct pickup/dropoff for the Ränneborg endpoint.

end.name: Hult Björnshult
end.caveats: Closest verified stop found, but not practical as simple trailhead access. Timetable appears weekday-oriented and valid 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14.

end.name: Hult riksväg 40
end.caveats: Better regional-service option than Hult Björnshult, but too far for casual Skuruhatt access. Länsstyrelsen describes about 15 km by signed road from road 40 at Hult to reserve parking.

end.name: Skurugata parking / Skuruhatt access
end.caveats: Best end access. Park only in designated places; no overnight stay in motorhome/car/rooftop tent in the reserve.

serviceCaveats: JLT PDFs checked are valid 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14; verify live departures and later timetable periods before publication or use.
JLT Närtrafik is not a general hiker shuttle and has eligibility, booking and operating-window restrictions.
Eksjö Taxi may be a fallback for Skuruhatt pickup but private-customer availability was caveated on its site and should be prebooked/confirmed.
No ferry or boat access applies to HÖ17.

ferryOrBoat.notes: No ferry or boat component found for HÖ17 or access routes.

protectedAreas.name: Skurugata / Skuruhatt nature reserve
rulesSummary: Do not damage natural objects or dead wood.
Do not collect mosses, lichens or non-edible fungi.
Fires only at designated prepared fireplaces.
No overnighting in vehicle, motorhome, car or rooftop tent.
Tenting only in designated tent area.
Competitions/training in subarea C are prohibited or restricted by regulation.
protectedAreas.caveats: No reserve-specific dog-leash rule found in the 2025 regulation, but posted signs should still be checked.

protectedAreas.name: Skurugata Natura 2000 SE0310346

dogs.ruleSummary: Between 1 March and 20 August dogs must be supervised so they cannot run loose where wildlife exists; Jönköping Länsstyrelsen recommends strict control, preferably leash.

livestockAndHunting.notes: Skurugata has grazing/conservation context; close gates, keep distance from livestock and leash/control dogs. Hunting can occur; 'jakt pågår' signs are warnings rather than automatic closures, but current field signs should be followed.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: No active closure/reroute notice found on checked HÖ17, Skurugata or Klinten official pages. Reserve pages said no current news. Storm Dave remains a regional windthrow caution but no HÖ17-specific closure was found.
closuresAndCurrentness.caveats: Local signs and field conditions can supersede web pages.

maintenanceAndSafety.notes: Länsstyrelsen notes reduced protected-area management funding since 2023 can affect fallen trees, brushy sections, unclear markings, closed toilets, removed bins and firewood supply. This is a general reserve risk, not HÖ17-specific.

conditionReports.finding: HÖ17 listed as 18.5 km, 4 h 40 min, red/krävande. Naturkartan showed 0 reviews and no current user condition notes or alerts.
conditionReports.confidence: high for official baseline; absence of reports is not proof of clear trail

conditionReports.finding: Current-news section showed no news. Page describes marked trails and Skurugata hazards: stones, boulders, fallen trees, slippery surfaces and snow/ice that may linger into spring or early summer.
Municipality says its leisure department maintains signs, bridges and shelters on Eksjö sections, with local associations doing inspections/minor work. No dated HÖ17 defect/closure found.
conditionReports.confidence: high for maintenance responsibility; not a condition report

conditionReports.finding: Storm Dave caused scattered windthrow; Jönköpings län was included in damage inventory areas and the public was warned to avoid windfalls and leaning trees.
conditionReports.confidence: medium regional relevance; no exact HÖ17 blockage found

conditionReports.finding: Reports note good signposting, fire site, toilets and parking; review area includes an 'obstructions' condition tag and notes rocky scrambling and slippery-after-rain conditions.
conditionReports.confidence: medium for endpoint context; not exact HÖ17 through-section

conditionReports.finding: Notes rocky/unstable ravine paths requiring good shoes, boardwalks over muddy places, and maintained lakeside picnic/shelter areas.

Mostly paths and forest roads, short gravel-road sections, clear orange markings; toilets at Skuruhatt and Klinten; two shelters and overnight cabin at Klinten; accessible path from parking to Skuruhatt.

sourceContradictions.details: No explicit API prev/next field was exposed. Numbering and endpoint labels imply HÖ16 connects at Ränneborg and HÖ1/HÖ2 connect at Skuruhatt, but the miniguide display order around HÖ17 was not the same as walking direction.
sourceContradictions.impact: Preserve endpoint topology and use official section numbers/order rather than UI card order for normalization.

sourceContradictions.details: The GPX endpoint aligns with the Skurugata/Skuruhatt parking/entrance area, while the Skuruhatt viewpoint itself is about 32 m off/near the final route segment and the official endpoint marker is about 17.873 m from GPX end.
sourceContradictions.impact: Use Skurugata/Skuruhatt ledentré/parking as endpoint access and model Skuruhatt viewpoint as a nearby importable facility.

sourceContradictions.topic: API v2 vs v3.2 linework resolution
sourceContradictions.details: Main-thread API v2 geometry matches GPX at 743 vertices; geometry lane reported v3.2 JSON:API linework at 525 vertices and 18.437323 km, with max segment 225.632 m.
sourceContradictions.impact: Use localized GPX/API v2 for route import; keep v3.2 as simplified corroboration only.

sourceContradictions.details: Geometry lane reported the embedded non-localized GPX URL resolved to HTML, while the localized Naturkartan GPX URL works.
sourceContradictions.impact: Use the localized official GPX URL recorded in this file.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/Naturkartan text mentions bus stop Ränneborg, but the transit lane could not verify an active JLT stop page or coordinates with that exact name; closest verified active stop found was Eksjö Västra Brudbadet.
sourceContradictions.impact: Do not publish Ränneborg as a resolved bus stop without verification; use verified JLT stops and caveat the official wording.

sourceContradictions.details: Official nearby inventory and facilities strongly support Klinten relevance, but rules lane cautioned exact HÖ17-only GPX intersection with Klinten reserve should be confirmed before segment-scoped reserve rules.
sourceContradictions.impact: Import coordinate-backed Klinten facilities near the route with reserve-rule context, but mark exact route-segment scoping as a GIS follow-up.

sourceContradictions.details: Rules lane found no confirmed potable water on official HÖ17/Ränneborg/Skuruhatt main pages, while facilities lane found official Skidstugan drinking-water metadata via an off-route side trail.
sourceContradictions.impact: Represent HÖ17 mainline as no confirmed potable water; represent Skidstugan water as off-route connected and seasonal/currentness caveated.

researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory and local GPX/API baseline. HÖ17 GPX has 743 points, one segment, 18.440039 km, no gaps over 100 m, one duplicate point, HÖ16-HÖ17 gap 0.118 m, HÖ17-HÖ2 gap about 2.521 m and direct GPX .kml/.geojson/.json unavailable.

Required six-lane HÖ17 research completed. No second targeted batch was needed because the remaining issues are normalization caveats: Ränneborg stop naming, Skuruhatt/Klinten facility dedupe and reserve scoping, Skidstugan off-route water/access, weak Skuruhatt transit and no exact post-Storm Dave HÖ17 condition report.
Main thread synthesized HÖ17 into this section JSON. The section is ready for normalization with caveats.

openQuestions: Verify whether an active JLT stop named Ränneborg exists or whether official wording should be replaced with verified nearby stops such as Eksjö Västra Brudbadet, Eksjö Ränneslätt and Eksjö Resecentrum.
GIS-confirm exact HÖ17 intersection with Klinten reserve before attaching route-segment reserve rules beyond facility/context metadata.
Deduplicate Skurugata/Skuruhatt endpoint facilities with existing HÖ1 and HÖ2 research before import.
Decide import policy for off-route but officially connected Skidstugan and Klinten/Försjön facilities.
Verify Skidstugan water availability/potability and seasonality before presenting it as reliable water.
Recheck HÖ17, Skurugata/Klinten reserve pages, local signs/fire-risk/fire-ban status and any Storm Dave blowdown notices before publication or route guidance.
Decide whether Eksjö town commercial services should be represented as one service cluster or individual POIs.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ17 has navigation-grade official GPX/API v2 geometry, strong endpoint continuity with HÖ16 and HÖ2/HÖ1, useful Ränneborg/Eksjö access, rich coordinate-backed facilities, and sufficient protected-area/currentness research. Main caveats are weak Skuruhatt public transport, Ränneborg bus-stop naming, Skuruhatt/Klinten/Skurugata deduplication, off-route facility policy, no confirmed mainline potable water, no exact post-Storm Dave condition report, reserve-rule GIS scoping and dynamic fire/currentness checks.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ18 Vikskvarn-Tomtabacken. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
